ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var destination = attributes.queryParams.destination default ""
--- if (isBlank(destination)) "SELECT * FROM american" else "SELECT * FROM american WHERE toAirport = '$(destination)'"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map ( payload01 , indexOfPayload01 ) -> { ID: payload01.ID, code: (payload01.code1 default "") ++ (payload01.code2 default ""), price: payload01.price default 0, departureDate: payload01.takeOffDate as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"}, origin: payload01.fromAirport default "", destination: payload01.toAirport default "", emptySeats: payload01.seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type": payload01.planeType default "", totalSeats: payload01.totalSeats default 0 } }

%dw 2.0 output application/json
var object = payload[0] --- { ID: payload[0].ID, code: (payload[0].code1 default "") ++ (payload[0].code2 default ""), price: payload[0].price default 0, departureDate: payload[0].takeOffDate as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"}, origin: payload[0].fromAirport default "", destination: payload[0].toAirport default "", emptySeats: payload[0].seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type": payload[0].planeType default "", totalSeats: payload[0].totalSeats default 0 } }
